status: Exploratory matched-SOTA smoke test; the five target outcomes were examined before this method family was registered.
claim_boundary: This experiment can diagnose whether causal shared training closes the matched MatPhys split gap. It cannot establish a new SOTA claim; a successful family must be frozen and evaluated on an independent preregistered cohort.
scientific_hypothesis: A shared teacher-centered spring residual can learn transferable material/dynamics structure when its input is restricted to an early causal video prefix but its supervision uses complete trajectories from disjoint source interactions.

source_split_provenance.split_rule: MatPhys random case split with seed 42, reconstructed from the released checkpoint and dataset ordering

information_boundary.source_video_input: first 75 percent of each released source training prefix
information_boundary.source_supervision: complete registered source trajectory, including frames after the source video prefix
information_boundary.target_training_access: none beyond split metadata and predeclared evidence boundaries
information_boundary.target_inference_input: first 75 percent of each released target training prefix
information_boundary.target_family_selection: remaining 25 percent of the released target training prefix
information_boundary.target_future: opened only after the target family choice is frozen
information_boundary.checkpoint_selection: fixed terminal epoch; no target metric or target frame is used

model.identity_fallback: zero residual is the exact released PhysTwin spring field

competence_gate.public_checkpoint_control: Reject an imported proposal when at least 99 percent of object springs lie at one decoder bound or spatial log-stiffness standard deviation is below 1e-4.
competence_gate.source_training_smoke: Require finite source loss and a nondegenerate predicted spring field before target Warp evaluation.
competence_gate.target_family_gate: Choose learned or exact teacher separately per target using only the disjoint target prefix validation interval; ties select teacher.

primary_metrics: NEES and coverage when covariance is available

success_rule.minimum: improve both matched target future metrics over the exact-teacher/discrepancy reference without target-tuned hyperparameters
success_rule.frontier: close the approximately 8.5 percent CD and 14 percent track gap to the published MatPhys means on its own five-case split
success_rule.next_step: Only a passing frozen family advances to an independent preregistered evaluation.

forbidden: target future RGB, depth, tracks, masks, or point clouds during training
target metrics for checkpoint or hyperparameter selection
changing source or target membership after target inspection
calling this already examined split independent, confirmatory, or a new SOTA result
calling graph-part proxy inputs a reproduction of unpublished MatPhys preprocessing
